title: Tara and Nibble's Season Surprise
markdown:
Explorers, gather ‘round! I’ve seen wonders, but a puzzle at Auntie June’s market stall stumped Tara and her mouse friend, Nibble.

“Sparkly strawberries! Fluffy chicks!” squeaked Nibble.
“Last month, pumpkins and hats!” said Tara. “Why does the stall change?”
Auntie June chuckled. “A secret nature shares, my dear.”

Days tiptoed by. The sun gave a big, warm hug. The stall burst with juicy cherries and sunny fruits. Tara giggled, “Plants are hungry for sunshine!”

Then, the sun’s hugs felt less warm. Oranges vanished. Bumpy gourds and red apples appeared. The air felt cooler, and cozy sweaters came out. Leaves turned fiery red and yellow, then danced down. “Leaves are napping!” Tara squeaked.

A breezy afternoon brought plump grapes and warm scarves. “It’s chilly,” said Tara, pulling her cardigan tight. Nibble shivered in her pocket.
“It is,” Auntie June soothed. “Do you know why?”

Tara thought. Sunshine, changing leaves, cooler air. “The sun changes how it warms us!” she said. “Warm sun means yummy fruits! Colder means other fruits are ready. And warm clothes keep us snug when it’s cold!”

Auntie June beamed. “Exactly! Each special time is a season. Spring is for waking up. Summer for sunshine fruits. Autumn for harvest. Winter for rest! Our clothes keep us just right!”

Tara looked at the stall. A storybook of the year! “The fruits and clothes are clues for the season!” she clapped.
“Precisely!” said Auntie June. “Nature is clever!”

Nibble poked his head out. “No carrots in winter?” he frowned.
Tara laughed. “Maybe baked apples, Nibble! I wonder what other secrets nature has!”
characters: Tara the tiny tinkerer, Nibble the mouse, Auntie June
